en-US.description: A New Standard for Image Viewers
en-US.longDescription: BandiView is the succeeding image viewer to Honeyview, that inherits everything cool of its predecessor and also gets improved even further. Fast and easy to view images in a variety of formats, from the most common ones to the most professional ones.
en-US.name: BandiView
